title: Every durable timeline command is named in the skill with its wire type

installed_sdk.rationale: No installed header, target, or exported symbol changes. The commands the catalog documents were already declared in core/timeline/include/pulp/timeline/command.hpp and are unmodified; this slice only writes them down and adds a repository gate.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No CLI verb, flag, or handler is added or changed. pulp seq apply already decoded every wire type in the catalog; documenting them changes what a caller can discover, not what the CLI accepts.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool definition or handler is added or changed. pulp_timeline_command_apply already accepted every wire type in the catalog.

live_product_control.rationale: No capability, operation, executor binding, or profile policy changes. The gate reads a manifest-derived artifact and a skill document; neither is reachable from a live product control.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: docs/status/agent-capabilities.json is unchanged. The catalog is skill prose an agent reads, not a published design-time capability.
